summary: Lineage edge: CNs-as-predicates (PTQ) vs CNs-as-types (CL20). After the one re-encoding move (man : Entity -> Prop becomes the subset type inter_cn Entity man), quantified sentences are provably equivalent both ways (every/some/no), and conservativity transfers through the encoding. The selection-restriction divergence is documented as meta-level (grade 0): 'walk(the number two)' is a false-or-true sentence in PTQ and a non-term in MTT.

sources.citation: Montague 1973 (via atlas/montague/PTQ.v); Chatzikyriakidis & Luo 2020 §3.2-3.3 (via atlas/mtt_ranta/MTT.v); Luo 2012.

definitions_mapped.coq: ManT := MTT.inter_cn Entity man; walkT := walk o proj1_sig
definitions_mapped.note: the encoding IS the edge's grade-1 finding on cn-ontology

theorems.name: conservativity_transfers
theorems.source_claim: B&C universals commute with the encoding

evidence: All four theorems close under the global context.
omissions: the selection-restriction split is prose (E5), deliberately: not statable with comparable instruments

determination_rationale: Pure bridge over the two audited files.
